description:
Squeeze Client is an Android client/controller application for the Lyrion music server (formerly known as Logitech media server or Squeezebox server) with Material Design 3 UI.
Features
• Music library browser
• Music library search quick access
• Playback and volume control
• Playlist management
• Multi-player management
• Music download
• Support for Light and dark theme as well as following system theme
• Full integration with system media controls
